descriptionByte:
Scope:

Jean Monnet actions in other fields of education and training - Teacher trainings will support higher education institutions, teacher training institutions and other institutions supporting and enhancing the development of teacher’s knowledge and skills regarding the teaching about European Union.

Type of applicants targeted: higher education institutions, teacher-training institutes and other institutions providing initial and/or in service training to teachers of schools and/or VET institutions established in an EU Member State or third country associated to the Programme.
